title: Elite: Restore the Noon Court Boss Dais: Boss Chamber
description: Elite: Restore the Noon Court Boss Dais: Boss Chamber is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Sun-Scale Verdict Descent through The Sun-Scale Gate (Stable Gate under Ma’at strain). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Aten Ra, Sutekh, Iset, Amunet enters; this beat spotlights Iset as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the boss step at Noon Court Boss Dais, using sacred judgment temple-road descent pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use Aten sun-discs with life-giving hand-rays, electrum collars, nemes-like light mantles, faience turquoise and lapis inlays, black Nile silt glass, red desert jasper, scarab engines, Ma’at feather geometry, solar barque arcs, pylon harnesses, lion/cobra/falcon/jackal threshold masks, lotus-papyrus river courts, and white-gold noon light.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Sun-Scale Verdict Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Noon Court Boss Dais and reveals: Why the Sun-Scale Gate judges travelers before admitting them. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Earth — Ancient Egypt, The Great Pyramid. inside the last surviving wonder — corridors twisted by Gate energy, burial chambers overflowing with void-mist, the King's Chamber where the Gate nexus pulses at the heart of the pyramid. Elite Hollow encounter in the avatar's mythological homeland, ancient era.
